entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I know my call was rather sudden.[n]I can only apologize.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We've already decided we're going to[n]oppose Dr. Maruki, so I know it's far[n]too late to say anything, but...
What's wrong?
You can't even look at me?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I just can't keep averting my eyes[n]from the truth...!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I betrayed you, and all we stand for![n]How can I pretend I'm still worthy of[n]our lofty ideals? Or your support!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm... I'm an utterly hopeless fool!
Where's this coming from?
Nah, you're just kinda weird.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Forgive me. Let me start from the[n]beginning.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Please, I don't deserve consoling...!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You gave me my strength. You taught me[n]to face the truth without fear...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That strength—that anger is how I rose up[n]against Madarame. I saw him for the fraud[n]he was, and I freed myself from his lies...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And just look at what I've become.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Dr. Maruki gave me a false security. He[n]showed me a life spun from my deepest[n]desires, and fool that I am, I welcomed it!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What indescribable humiliation...! How[n]could I be such a detestable, narrow-[n]minded sheep of a man!?
Calm down.
Take a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I cannot! This is no time for calm!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And you! You of all people deserve to[n]shame me, but still you say nothing!?[n]I betrayed you...!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have spat on the very principles of art![n]And more than that—I have spat on all[n]you did to help me find my answers!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm nothing... Not even worth the empty[n]words I spoke...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can't even bring myself to look you in[n]the eye... Forgive me, [fName]...
Such is the human heart.
Isn't there beauty in it?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are our hearts truly so deluded? Are we[n]foolish enough to cling to these[n]misguided fantasies!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...You offer me mercy I do not deserve![n]There is no beauty in this!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Impossible!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What human beauty could possibly be[n]buried in this hellscape of humiliation!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No... I refuse to accept it! It would be[n]nothing but an excuse for my failure!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was a slave to my hubris all along.[n]How did I ever believe the meaning of[n]true beauty was within my grasp...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was just a fool, lost in dreams!
So you're giving up?
It's a beginning, not an end.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Giving up...? [fName], I...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I... see. Perhaps there is truth in that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can only apologize. You've saved me[n]from repeating my mistakes once more.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Compared to the grand legacy of my[n]mother's art... I am still but a chick[n]toddling in her shadow as she soars.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I dreamed of flying at her side. Yet for[n]all my leaps of faith, I only plummeted[n]from my nest, again and again...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What I needed... was a teacher.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To grasp the beauty in my mother's[n]work... I needed a guiding hand, to offer[n]criticism and validation as I earned it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But why was I so convinced that my[n]teacher must be someone in the art[n]world?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: After all, I have a friend like you...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And our talks together have already[n]led me to so many beautiful revelations.
You're gripping kind of hard...
Personal space, Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My apologies—I got ahead of myself.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But my point stands. I believe there is[n]still a great deal I can learn from you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And if that's true... then I've found my[n]teacher. And with him, the path to[n]truly grasping my mother's art.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will not lose my way again...[n]Let us walk that path together!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see... So this power is both my core,[n]and my essence.
Yusuke's Persona [clr 1]Kamu Susano-o[clr 27] has[n]transformed into [clr 2]Gorokichi[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName]... This reality of ideals[n]and perfections—it's not wholly wrong.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Truly, there are parts of it I find[n]almost painfully beautiful.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However... you have helped me see[n]clearly again. I believe I wish to return[n]to our own reality.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It suits me far better to paint with both[n]ugliness and beauty upon my palette.
That's the Yusuke I know.
You good now?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ha! Indeed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let us return to our true home. To the[n]reality where I discovered true beauty.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Ah, but first... you know what they say[n]about fighting on an empty stomach.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That reminds me—I haven't even offered[n]you any tea yet. And you brought some[n]kind of treat with you too, didn't you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is it sweet bean jelly? Or maybe[n]a baked dessert, like dorayaki?[n]Or perhaps you've brought...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thank you for spending all this time[n]with me. See you again soon.
